query: EXPLAIN MATCH (n:V01) WHERE n.uid IN $dimensionUids RETURN n.uid AS uid,n.widthM AS widthM,n.depthM AS depthM,n.groundZM AS groundZM,n.eaveZM AS eaveZM,n.eaveZM-n.groundZM AS ownEaveHeightM,n.widthM/n.depthM AS widthDepthRatio,(n.eaveZM-n.groundZM)/n.widthM AS ownEaveHeightWidthRatio,n.measurementBoundaryBasis AS basis ORDER BY uid
